[2026-11-10] rc:4526094663 inline on src/private_broadcast.cpp by optout21 (member):
After reconsidering, I'm also for keeping the current logic. My suggestion would add further complexity, and would not solve all inconsistencies. The root cause is that a submission can be repeated, but he hearing back will likely not. Resubmission is not a regular use case, but if it's done, the user has to know that the received info will only be valid since the resubmission.
So for me it's fine like this.
</new_statements>
